findings.location: inputs/project/rc_filter.kicad_pcb (via b71a70d7 at 113,100; zone 38a83012 on B.Cu)
findings.mechanism: If the saved fill were stale relative to the layout, or the single via failed in fabrication, the capacitor ground would float and the filter output would follow the input (no low-pass action). The run could not refill the zone to re-derive connectivity, so correctness rests on the saved filled_polygon plus the DRC/probe connectivity counts.
findings.reasoning: I traced the saved fill polygon and it does enclose the via solidly and connect J1.3 through spokes, and both DRC and the probe report zero unconnected items, so as-saved the net is continuous and no requirement is violated (no redundancy or via-count requirement is declared for this disposable fixture). Recorded as an informational concern because the entire ground return is a single-point path verified only against the saved fill state, which the declared limitations acknowledge cannot be re-generated.
findings.title: GND continuity relies on a single 0.6/0.3 mm via and the as-saved back-side zone fill
